name: d-op-v2
description: d-OP v2 Bun workspace (extension + share web + shared). Legacy loadable root extension is untouched; see docs/decisions/001-toolchain.md.

scripts.dev:extension: cd apps/extension && bunx wxt dev --browser chrome
scripts.dev:extension:firefox: cd apps/extension && bunx wxt dev --browser firefox
scripts.build: cd apps/extension && bunx wxt build --browser chrome && bunx wxt build --browser firefox && cd ../web && bunx astro build
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:worker && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:browser:firefox: bun -e "console.error('task-5/task-23 own test:browser:firefox (native harness): not implemented');process.exit(1)"
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && cd apps/extension && bunx wxt prepare && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && cd ../web && bun run check
scripts.verify:artifacts: bun -e "console.error('task-25 owns verify:artifacts (packaging checker): not implemented');process.exit(1)"
scripts.verify:upgrade: bun -e "console.error('task-26 owns verify:upgrade (migration rehearsal): not implemented');process.exit(1)"
scripts.verify:staging: bun -e "console.error('task-28 owns verify:staging (remote staging proof): not implemented');process.exit(1)"
scripts.verify:cutover: bun -e "console.error('task-29 owns verify:cutover (production cutover proof): not implemented');process.exit(1)"
